notes: The opening fragment nier continues a word from a preceding sheet. No other sheet or image was consulted.

The heading is Cas principal, underlined, with a separate live period. The criterion has an unfilled blank before (1)=0. The map expression also has an unfilled gap before G.

The second paragraph discusses a principal class of homomorphisms in the sense of Dynkin-Kostant, the Borel property of P, the unit group Z_o, and a torsor statement for Dyn_c. These are reports of the page, not independently established claims.

No date or authorial page number is visible. The lower-left 19 is treated as an archive sheet number. The large lower area is otherwise blank apart from small non-textual specks.
